goalZh: 综合运用本单元的说法,在查房时回答问题、说明家务安排
canDoZh: 能在查房时回答工作人员的问题,说明房间里东西的位置和平时的家务安排

newItems.noteZh: Your room is really neat! 你们房间真整洁!;口语里 neat 还有"真棒"的意思。
代词放中间:take it away;away 重音在后 a-WAY。
高兴时举手互相拍一下:High five!;也可以说 Give me five!。

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: Hi! Dorm inspection. Can I come in?
lines.zh: (周五上午,宿舍办公室的工作人员来查房)你们好!查房。我能进来吗?

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: Wow, your room is really neat!

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Thanks! We cleaned all day yesterday.
lines.zh: 谢谢!我们昨天打扫了一整天。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: We take turns. Our chore list is on the whiteboard.
lines.zh: 我们轮流做。家务清单写在白板上。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Monday, Ethan takes out the trash. Tuesday, I do the dishes.
lines.zh: 周一伊森倒垃圾,周二我洗碗。

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: Great idea! Now, can I see your closet?
lines.zh: 好主意!现在我能看看你们的衣柜吗?

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: Oh. Is that a space heater?

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Yes. It's mine. Our heater was broken!
lines.zh: 是,是我的。我们的暖气之前坏了!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: But a worker came by yesterday. It's OK now.
lines.zh: 不过昨天工人来过了,现在好了。

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: Good. But space heaters aren't allowed. Sorry, I have to take it away.
lines.zh: 那就好。不过电暖器是不允许的。抱歉,我得把它拿走。

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: Your room is perfect. You passed!
lines.zh: 你们的房间很完美。通过了!

questions.prompt: 工作人员觉得他们的房间怎么样?
questions.explainZh: Wow, your room is really neat!——neat 是"整洁";他们昨天打扫了一整天。

options: 两人轮流,清单写在白板上
questions.explainZh: We take turns. Our chore list is on the whiteboard.——两人轮流,周一伊森倒垃圾,周二磊洗碗。

questions.prompt: 工作人员为什么拿走了电暖器?
questions.explainZh: But space heaters aren't allowed. Sorry, I have to take it away.——宿舍规定不许用电暖器(查房通知里也写了)。
Your room is perfect. You passed!——顺利通过,磊和伊森击掌庆祝。

grammar.titleZh: 单元小结:家务、请求、位置和规矩
grammar.bodyZh:
① 家务搭配整块记:do the dishes、do laundry、make the bed、take out the trash(代词放中间:take it out、take it away);② 请人做事:Can you…? —— Sure. / In a minute. / Sorry, I can't right now.;轮流:We take turns. / It's your turn.;③ 东西的位置:under、behind、between、above、inside + 名词;④ 规矩和告示:Please… / Don't… / No + 名词 / … aren't allowed.;⑤ 报修:I'm calling about… / There's a problem with… / It makes a loud noise.。
发音:列举家务时前几项升调、最后一项降调:Monday, Ethan takes out the trash ↗; Tuesday, I do the dishes ↘.

examples.text: Can you take out the trash? — Sure, in a minute.
examples.zh: 你能去倒垃圾吗?——行,等一下。

examples.zh: 我们轮流做。家务清单写在白板上。
